description: This file defines an enumeration `OpenClawKitResources` that manages locating a resource bundle for the OpenClawKit project. It includes methods to locate the bundle in various environments such as packaged apps, SwiftPM development, and tests, with fallbacks to ensure resource accessibility. The code helps avoid fatal crashes due to missing resource bundles by implementing multiple lookup strategies.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used for locating the bundle via its type, enabling `Bundle(for:)` references.

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Main method to locate the resource bundle by trying different locations based on environment: inside main bundle, via module, or fallback to main bundle.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Attempts to find the module's resource bundle by checking various probable paths without risking a fatal error.
